title: San Bruno: preserve the provenance of configuration data
focus: Digitizing a record does not validate the physical configuration it describes.

sources.title: NTSB Pipeline Accident Report PAR-11/01
sources.limitations: Relevant sections inspected; this is not a reconstruction of every event or finding.

facts.statement: The pipeline GIS described the rupture segment as seamless pipe using information traced through a survey sheet to an accounting voucher with an erroneous material description.
Investigators found welded short pipe sections with defects and configuration details that were not reflected in the GIS.

retrospective.boundary: Physical asset, construction records, accounting records, survey sheets, GIS, integrity analysis, inspections, and operating decisions form the configuration-evidence chain.
interfaces: Legacy record → digital model: transformation must preserve origin and confidence instead of laundering uncertainty.
Model attribute → integrity decision: uncertain material identity changes which analyses are applicable.

decision.question: What should happen when an important configuration field has weak provenance?
options: Treat a populated database field as authoritative.
Mark the uncertainty, bound its decision consequences, and seek suitable confirming evidence.
decision.recommendation: Differentiate administrative records, engineering records, and observations of the installed asset.
decision.uncertainty: A missing record does not by itself prove a defect; it limits the claims that can be supported.

rows: Engineering record or suitable physical confirmation
Flag analyses sensitive to uncertain fields
Conservative bounds and owned resolution plan

questions: How can information become more convincing without becoming more accurate?
What should a digital twin display when material identity is unresolved?
Write an uncertainty statement that avoids both false assurance and unsupported failure claims.
answer_signals: Tracks the origin of each decision-critical attribute.
Separates absence of evidence from evidence of defect.
retrospective.transfer_exercise: Synthetic: migrate a legacy asset registry into a digital model. Define three provenance classes and rules preventing unsupported promotion to verified.
retrospective.limits: No pipeline integrity calculation or operating recommendation is made. All new ledger IDs are instructional.
